statement.zh: 《成都考古发现（2009）》刊布新津宝墩遗址2009–2010年调查与试掘简报，记录成都平原晚新石器城址材料。
statement.en: Chengdu Archaeological Discoveries (2009) publishes the 2009–2010 Baodun survey/test brief for a late Neolithic walled site on the Chengdu Plain.
